title: Baked Beef Empanadas with Olives and Raisins
summary: Spiced beef mince bound with a bread paste is cooked with onion, cumin and cloves, finished with raisins, olives and vinegar and chilled, then folded into masa pastry and baked on hot oiled trays until crisp.

ingredients.item: plain flour, plus extra for rolling
fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: 2 tbsp for the bread paste, the rest for simmering

ingredients.item: beef mince (15% fat), from a butcher
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the paste
steps.text: Blend the bread with a little stock, then pulse in the beef and seasoning.

steps.title: Cook the filling
steps.text: Brown the onions, add spices and beef and cook to 71 °C, then simmer with stock until moist.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Stir in coriander, raisins, olives and vinegar and chill about 1 hour.

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: Process the flours, sugar, salt and butter, then mix in ice water; divide into 12 and chill.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Roll into 15 cm rounds, fill, fold, seal and crimp with a fork.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake on preheated oiled trays at 220 °C for 25-30 minutes until browned.

tips: Cold filling keeps the pastry from going soft before it bakes.
Preheating the oiled trays gives a crisp, fried-style base.
Shaped empanadas freeze well; bake from frozen with 5 extra minutes.
storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours for up to 3 days. Reheat at 190 °C for 10-15 minutes until piping hot (74 °C in the centre).
